column3: “what belongs on it” renders “its arrangement,” and “mount its lamps” renders “lift up its lamps.”
“the veil for the doorway” renders “the screen of the entrance.”
“the veil for the gateway” renders “the screen of the gate.”
“shall qualify them for” renders “shall be for them.”
“the mercy seat” renders “kapporet,” the atonement cover.
“a veil for the screen” renders “the curtain of the screen,” and “screened off” renders “covered over.”
“the veil for the doorway” renders “the screen of the entrance.”
